notes.title: Steam Awards: Puqq is in!
notes.content:
Die Steam Awards stehen vor der Tür.
Nun heißt es den Götzner aufsuchen und euren Lohn für eure Treue abzuholen, denn mit eurer Stimme kann Puqq noch mehr Spieler für die Arbeit unter Poggos Aufsicht begeistern.

Es wartet viel Loot auf mutige Bergräuber - wirst du dich ihnen anschließen?

The Steam Awards are coming.
Now it is time to visit the Fanatic and get your share for being so loyal, because your vote will bring Puqq to even more players. They will, as you, work under Poggo's watch. Ready for another shift in the shafts?

Much loot is waiting for brave miners - will you join them?

notes.title: Start digging today!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43863122/a13e014fec7993a0330061fdc0927b52b8af55d6.png[/img]

Let's go!

From now on, shafts are open to you and you can dig and laser in the love of the lord of the rocks! The loot is endless, only in the car, it quickly gets tight.

Try your luck and save your community from starving and dying!

notes.title: Release-Geschenk!
notes.content:
Uky! UKY!
Whats up here?
Puqq is about to begin his adventure and wants to start digging, so the god of ores has given him a small gift. Go "down" after staring the game to get automatically some Glathuron into your cart.

What are you waiting for? Start digging now!
